ctx.x: Recording for Moe Asch, was that different from recording for other people?

Yes, it was different because Moe Ash had more love and he had more respect for jazz artists. Often he would take us to dinner, the nicest dinners, steak dinners, the nicest places and it was his idea that an artist should be heard if they're talented. He'd turn the tape on and go away, let you record anything you wanted to record and it always worked out great. He wanted to record Erroll Garner, you know. Erroll Garner was in Pittsburgh.
